items: Use {Bladestorm} inside {Colossus Smash}, and keep up your interrupt turns with {Pummel} and {Storm Bolt} during it

colossus.title: Colossus key points
items: Use {Demolish} inside {Colossus Smash} after building {Colossal Might}
On big pulls, chain cooldown-free {Cleave} casts from {Crushing Combo} after {Colossus Smash}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield (Topicx). Use Colossus Smash (45 sec) on every shield and Avatar (1 min 30 sec) on every shield as well, and the Colossus build puts Demolish on the shield target. If an unclaimed Messy Eater pool is far away, Heroic Leap onto it and Charge back to the boss

[위치] If you are a Triple Shot target (116379 Nature, 3 players), pop Spell Reflection beforehand. The reflecting target gets no 5 yd circle or dot, so the party only has 2 circles to deal with (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry (3 min) as the party defensive for Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to the whole party) (Topicx). If Regurgitate slows you by 50%, clear it with Berserker Rage (Fearless)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Pummel into the three-cast Toxic Atrophy interrupt order agreed in chat before the pull. The Slayer build can Pummel during Bladestorm through Unrelenting Onslaught

[광역 피해] If Bloodlust was saved for the second boss, it goes out on the Uncoil split (Topicx), so line up Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build) with it, and cut down all 5 Writhes together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave
[제어] Once the Writhes are grouped, Shockwave them together to stop Toxic Atrophy casts and keep them from reaching the Spiteful Hunt target (Topicx)
Zul'jan: [위치] Return to the same assigned spot for every Ritual of the Fang (Topicx). If your spot is far away, Heroic Leap there before the channel
[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry as the party defensive during the 8 sec beam-soak channel (Topicx), and pop Spell Reflection while taking the beam (38793 Nature every 1 sec) to take 20% less magic damage
[참고] After clearing Ritual Venom with Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe, top yourself off with Impending Victory (heals 30% of max health) if your health is low

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation, so Pummel it whenever Pummel (15 sec) is ready (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec, so go in with Spell Reflection (20% less magic damage for 5 sec) up, and when the beam ends, clear the patch's 50% slow with Berserker Rage (Fearless) as you step out
[회피] If you are targeted by Thornblade, Heroic Leap out of Fan Of Thorns' 15 yd range and come back with Charge
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Thorncaller Roar (82435 Nature over 6 sec) to take 20% less magic damage
[회피] If you are the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, open distance with Heroic Leap and use the Bounding Stride speed to drag the boss toward the roots. If Verdant Stomp knocks you back, return with Charge

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when there is no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase (Topicx), so line up Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) with it, and keep Die by the Sword and Rallying Cry for the Lightcrazed Frenzy AoE
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Pummel in the interrupt rotation for Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature), which repeats on the tank during Moonkin Form

[위치] If you get a Pulverizing Strikes mark, do not Heroic Leap or Charge; stand still and aim the cone away from the party. Take the 164870 Physical hits every 2 sec in Defensive Stance (Stance Mastery cuts hits of 20% or more of your max health by another 15%), and if Grievous Thrash bleed is still on you, top yourself off with Impending Victory before the cones
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Lightfire, Heroic Leap away from the party so Lightfire Beams do not cover them. Save Die by the Sword and Rallying Cry for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Once the tank holds the Lashers in the middle of the pack, Pummel the pre-revive Lashers' Lightspore Shot, and if 3 or more are gathered, stop them together with Shockwave so Rumbling Earth cuts its cooldown by 15 sec. Neither works on revived Lashers
[광역 피해] When the Lashers spawn, cut them down together with the boss using Sweeping Strikes and Cleave
[참고] Backing up to the far right edge of the platform pulls an Overgrown Hydra (Topicx), so do not Heroic Leap or Charge to that edge

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is physical damage that ignores armor, so pop Die by the Sword
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, Heroic Leap and Charge to step on them and come back
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Pummel into the interrupt order for the two Fractured Shivercores' Winter's Shroud (4 sec cast), and stop it with Storm Bolt if it is missed

[우선 처치] Melee take the add next to the boss (Topicx), so hit it together with the boss using Sweeping Strikes, and time Colossus Smash and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) on your add so its health stays even with the ranged add
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Frozen Tempest (38793 Frost every 1 sec). If you are on Rimeshatter soak duty, Heroic Leap there within 6 sec
Nalorakk: [위치] If you are an Echoing Maul target, Heroic Leap within 4 sec to the corner chosen for this set so the Echoes spread evenly around the room (Topicx). Pop Spell Reflection for the 193965 Nature as the Echo lands, and add Die by the Sword if your health is low (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Take Overwhelming Onslaught (three 315193 armor-ignoring Physical hits on everyone) behind Zul'jarra's shield in Defensive Stance (Stance Mastery cuts hits of 20% or more of your max health by another 15%), then Charge back after the knockback and switch back to Battle Stance
[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, pop Spell Reflection while blocking Echoes and taking Echoing Fury (67888 Nature)

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] During the 20 sec Destabilized, pile Colossus Smash, Avatar, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) into Kystia. Kystia needs to reach about 40% in the first window so she dies in the second (Topicx), so delay cooldowns by only a few seconds to line them up, never more than 10-15% of their cooldown (Wowhead)
[차단] Interrupt your assigned image's Felstorm from Mirror Images with Pummel and Storm Bolt, and if several are grouped, stop them with Shockwave

[광역 피해] If Corroding Spittle (30 sec Fire dot) lands on you or while you take the Destabilized party dot (48491 Chaos every 1 sec), pop Spell Reflection to take 20% less magic damage, and add Die by the Sword if the dispel is late
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] When the boss appears, the second Bloodlust goes out and the worker pack is killed together with it (Topicx), so turn on Sweeping Strikes and use Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build) on the workers and the boss together

[광역 피해] Killing Spree (38793 armor-ignoring Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) is a spot for party defensives (Topicx), so use Rallying Cry on your agreed turn, and pop Die by the Sword when it is not your turn

[위치] If the barrels are far before Murder in a Row, Heroic Leap behind a Forbidden Freight first. Several players can hide behind one barrel, and a shot barrel explodes 5 sec later, so Charge back to the boss after that
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] When Demonic Rage makes the boss take 30% more damage, line up Colossus Smash and Avatar. The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx), so use Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) then too

[우선 처치] When the Axe Toss axe lands, switch your main target to it immediately and spill damage onto the boss with Sweeping Strikes. The party member tethered to the axe cannot move, so breaking the axe comes first
[회피] Spread loosely before Infernal Crush (96982 Fire plus an 8 sec dot) and pop Spell Reflection. If the axe is still alive, use Rallying Cry as the party defensive (Topicx)
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Pummel in the Chaos Bolt interrupt rotation, and if you are the target, pop Spell Reflection to take 20% less magic damage
[제어] When Fingers of Gul'dan gathers the Wild Imps, stop their Felfire Burst all at once with Shockwave (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on the Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns, not the boss (Topicx), so line up Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build) with the add spawns and spill onto the boss with Sweeping Strikes

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Dark Bloom (174568 Shadow to the whole party plus Void Fissure) is the biggest party damage in this fight, so use Rallying Cry (3 min) here (Topicx) and pop Spell Reflection for yourself
[회피] After dodging the Void Fissure orbs, Charge straight back to the boss to cut your downtime
Atroxus: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out when the first Toxic Creeper spawns (Topicx), so line up Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) on the Creeper and spill damage onto the boss with Sweeping Strikes
[광역 피해] Monstrous Roar is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so pop Die by the Sword
Charonus: [광역 피해] Spread for the Cosmic Crash circles (116379 Shadow within 8 yd plus a 20 sec dot); DPS need a defensive here (Topicx), so pop Spell Reflection

[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry as the party defensive while orbs are being dragged through the puddles (Topicx)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] When Lucre's Call brings out Animated Gold, stun several with Shockwave and slow their approach to the boss with Hamstring
[광역 피해] Use Sweeping Strikes and Cleave on the Animated Gold pack, and throw Ravager on the Colossus build

[광역 피해] If you are the Drain Fluids target (Nature dot), pop Die by the Sword or Spell Reflection

[참고] If you are the Severing Axe target (Physical bleed) from Kula, pop Die by the Sword, and if an Explosive Totem is far away, Charge to it and break it before Explode

[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection on the Gilded Destruction Fire AoE, and use Die by the Sword during the 15 sec party dot

Melidrussa Chillworn: [참고] The tank interrupts Frigid Shard right after Hailburst, so use Pummel only when the tank misses it

Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Pummel into the rotation for the Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley

[위치] When the Firestorm casts Burnout as it dies, Heroic Leap out past 20 yards, then Charge back

[광역 피해] Save Bladestorm (Slayer) or Demolish (Colossus) for phase 2 and pile it into the lower health boss after they merge (Topicx)
[회피] If you are the Inferno Spit target, an 8 yd Fire explosion comes when the 6 sec dot ends, so pop Spell Reflection at that moment

[광역 피해] If Gale Force pushes you away, Charge straight back (2 charges from Double Time), and pop Spell Reflection when you share Thunder and Lightning (Topicx)
Merektha: [제어] Break an ally out of A Knot of Snakes with Storm Bolt on the snake knot, and use Shockwave on the freed snakes (Topicx). Interrupt Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Pummel

[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry on the Serpentstorm knockback and 8 sec Nature dot, and pop Spell Reflection for yourself (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] Heroic Leap to reposition fast on Lightning Spire beam swaps, and pop Die by the Sword while Galvanized has your physical damage taken up 250%
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Put Colossus Smash and Avatar on the Essence Defiler and kill it first
[차단] Twisted Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so Flame Shock can only be stopped with Pummel. Do not miss your interrupt turn
[위치] If you soak Corrupted Lifeforce, get there fast with Heroic Leap, and pop Spell Reflection if you are the Vile Charge target (Shadow plus an 8 sec dot)

Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 20% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times.

436358.m: Talent · Melee Range · Channeled (2 sec cast) · 30 sec cooldown
436358.d:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing [(531.455% of Attack Power) + (531.455% of Attack Power) + (1232.36% of Attack Power)] damage to it, and (1232.36% of Attack Power) damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

440992.d: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

444767.d:
Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing (840.42% of Attack Power) Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

(500ms cooldown)

444769.d:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.

444780.d:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

1261049.d: Colossus Smash grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes.

1261051.d: Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death.

1261056.d: Colossus Smash causes your next 2 Cleaves within 20 sec to trigger no cooldown.

1261060.d:
Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer (145.48% of Attack Power) Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

1269307.d: Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional 3.0%. Stacks up to 5 times.

1269383.d: Powerfully strike an opponent, causing (600% of Attack Power) Physical damage and gaining a stack of Master of Warfare, allowing your attacks to penetrate 3% armor for 30 sec. Multiple applications of this effect may overlap.

1270704.d: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.

1270717.d: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.

1271925.d: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.

1271926.d: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

1280961.d:
Your stances have additional effects.

Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.

100.m: 8 - 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
100.d:
대상에게 돌진하여 (전투력의 21%)의 물리 피해를 입히고, 1초 동안 제자리에 묶 [전쟁인도자: 은 뒤, 활성화되어 있는 동안 기절시킵니다 / 습니다].

20의 분노를 생성합니다.

772.d: 적에게 깊은 상처를 남겨 (전투력의 124.581%)의 물리 피해를 입히고, 추가로 15초에 걸쳐 총 (전투력의 190.465%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

845.m: 특성 · 분노 20 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 4.5 초 재사용 대기시간
845.d:
전방에 있는 모든 적을 공격해 (전투력의 232.814%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. [분쇄: 모든 대상에게 분쇄를 부여합니다 /

분쇄를 배웠을 경우, 모든 대상에게 분쇄를 부여합니다.]

1464.d: 적을 강하게 후려쳐 (전투력의 303.485%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. [도검의 폭풍: 분노를10만큼 생성합니다.]

1715.d: 적의 신체를 손상시켜 (전투력의 15%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 15초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

6544.m: 특성 · 8 - 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
6544.d: 공중 도약 후 지면에 강력한 충격을 일으켜 대상 지역의 8미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게 (전투력의 23.5%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

6552.m: 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
6552.d: 적을 가격하여 주문 시전을 방해하고, 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 합니다.

6673.d: 1시간 동안 100미터 내의 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 전투력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

7384.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
7384.d: 적을 제압하여 (전투력의 385.614%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 방패로 막거나, 회피하거나, 무기로 막을 수 없습니다. [무예 기량: 다음 필사의 일격 또는 회전베기의 공격력이 (전투력의 385.614%)%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 1번까지 중첩됩니다] [다음 필사의 일격의 공격력이 (전투력의 385.614%)%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 1번까지 중첩됩니다]

12294.m: 특성 · 분노 30 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
12294.d: 잔혹하게 적을 공격하여 (전투력의 520.121%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 10초 동안 대상이 받는 치유 효과를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

18499.d: 광폭화하여 6초 동안 공포, 혼절시키기, 일부 행동 불가 상태를 제거하고 면역이 됩니다.

23920.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
23920.d: 무기를 치켜세워 자신에게 시전되는 첫 번째 주문을 반사합니다. 또한 5초 동안 받는 마법 피해가 20%만큼 감소합니다.

29725.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 1.7번 효과 발동됨
29725.d:
공격 시 일정 확률로 다음 마무리 일격을 분노를 소모하지 않고 대상의 생명력에 관계없이 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 일격은 40의 분노를 소모한 것과 같은 피해를 입힙니다.

(3초 재사용 대기시간)

46968.d: 충격의 파장을 부채꼴 모양으로 내보내 전방 10미터 안에 있는 모든 적 대상에게 (전투력의 20%)의 피해를 입히고 2초 동안 기절시킵니다.

57755.m: 8 - 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
57755.d: 적에게 무기를 던져 (전투력의 35%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 위협 수준이 크게 증가합니다.

97462.d:
재집결의 함성을 내질러 10초 동안 자신과 반경 40미터 내의 모든 파티원 또는 공격대원의 최대 생명력을 일시적으로 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

공격대에 속해 있지 않을 때는 생명력 증가량이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

103827.d: 돌진이 1회 추가로 충전됩니다. 또한 재사용 대기시간이 3초만큼 감소합니다.

107570.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
107570.d: 적에게 무기를 던져 (전투력의 28.5%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 4초 동안 기절시킵니다. [폭풍망치: 추가로 주위의 추가 대상 2명을 공격해 2초 동안 기절시킵니다]

107574.d: 거구로 변신하여 모든 공격력이 20%만큼 증가하고 광역 공격으로 받는 피해가 5%만큼 감소합니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.

118038.d: 8초 동안 무기 막기 확률이 100%만큼 증가하고 받는 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

152278.d: 20의 분노를 공격에 소모할 때마다 투신과 거인의 강타의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 1초만큼 감소합니다.

163201.m: 분노 20의 40 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
163201.d: 적에게 마무리 일격을 시도하여 소모한 분노에 따라 최대 [2.0 * (전투력의 242.125%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 생명력이 20% 미만인 적에게만 사용할 수 있습니다. [마무리 일격 연마: 적이 살아남으면 소모한 분노의 10%를 돌려받습니다]

167105.d:
지면을 강타하여 10미터 내의 모든 적의 방어구를 조각내고 (전투력의 306.263%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 적중당한 적에게 입히는 피해가 10초 동안 30%만큼 증가합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

Generates 15 Rage.

184783.d:
분노를 소모하는 공격 사용 시 30%의 확률로 제압이 충전됩니다.
사용 능력의 분노 소모량이 0으로 감소한 경우에도 이 효과는 적용됩니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

202163.d: 영웅의 도약의 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소하고, 영웅의 도약이 이동 속도를 3초 동안 70%만큼 증가시킵니다.

202168.m: 특성 · 연전연승을 대신함 · 분노 10 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
202168.d:
즉시 대상을 공격하여 (전투력의 59%)의 피해를 입히고 최대 생명력의 30%를 회복합니다.

적을 처치하고 경험치나 명예 점수를 받으면 예견된 승리의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화되고 분노를 소모하지 않습니다.

202316.d: 회전베기 또는 소용돌이가 3명 이상의 대상에게 적중하면 주 대상에게 격돌을 시전합니다. 이 격돌은 50%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

227847.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
227847.d:
멈출 수 없는 파괴의 소용돌이가 되어 6초 동안 주위 모든 적에게 [7 * (전투력의 271.635%)%]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 8명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

이동 방해 효과나 군중 제어 효과에 면역이 되며, 방어 능력을 사용하고 공격을 회피할 수 있습니다.

228920.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
228920.d:
대상에게 주위 적을 추적하는 소용돌이치는 무기를 던져 모든 적에게 12초에 걸쳐 [6 * (전투력의 179.276%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

쇠날발톱으로 피해를 받은 적은 12초 동안 시전자의 출혈 효과로 받는 피해가 50%만큼 증가합니다.

260708.d: 다음 12회 동안 사용하는 단일 대상 공격 능력이 8미터 내 1명의 추가 대상을 공격하여 75%의 피해를 입힙니다. 30초 동안 지속됩니다.

262150.d:
제압의 충격이 지진파를 일으켜 대상 주위 10미터 직선상에 있는 모든 적에게 (전투력의 140%)의 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

일격무쌍은 제압의 공격력을 변경하는 모든 효과를 받습니다.

275339.d: 충격파의 사정거리가 6미터만큼 증가합니다. 또한 3명 이상의 적에게 적중하면 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소합니다.

334779.d: 휩쓸기 일격의 지속시간 동안 능력을 사용해 두 번째 대상에게 피해를 입히면, 다음 회전베기 또는 소용돌이의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다.

386164.d:
균형 잡힌 전투 태세를 갖춰 능력의 치명타 및 극대화율이 3%만큼 증가하고 이동 방해 효과의 지속시간이 10%만큼 감소합니다.

취소할 때까지 지속됩니다.

386208.d:
방어적인 전투 태세를 갖춰 받는 모든 피해가 15%만큼 감소합니다. 모든 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

취소할 때까지 지속됩니다.

386628.d: 칼날폭풍으로 피해를 2회 입힐 때마다 자동으로 대상 또는 주위의 무작위 적에게 필사의 일격을 시전해 일반 공격력의 100%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

386634.d: 마무리 일격 사용 시 다음 필사의 일격의 공격력이 35%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

391271.d:
투사의 혼, 가로막기, 개입, 주문 반사, 폭풍망치, 들이치기의 재사용 대기시간이 10%만큼 감소합니다.

적의 주문 시전을 방해하는 데 성공하면 10초 동안 적에게 입히는 피해가 5%만큼 증가합니다.

424742.d:
외침 능력에 추가 효과가 부여됩니다.

전투의 외침:
전투력이 3%만큼 추가로 증가합니다.

재집결의 함성:
생명력이 2%만큼 증가하고 지속시간은 3초만큼 연장됩니다.

날카로운 고함:
반경이 100%만큼 증가합니다.

광전사의 외침:

위협의 외침:
재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소합니다.

429634.d:
거인의 힘이 다음 쇄파의 공격력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

필사의 일격 사용 시 거인의 힘 중첩을 얻습니다. 또한 회전베기가 3명 이상의 대상에게 적중하면 거인의 힘 중첩을 얻습니다.

429636.d:
쇄파에 영향을 받는 적은 10초 동안 시전자에게 받는 피해가 최대 10%만큼 증가하고, 시전자에게 입히는 피해는 최대 20%만큼 감소합니다. 이 효과는 쇄파로 소모한 거인의 힘 중첩에 따라 달라집니다.

거인의 힘이 최대 10번까지 중첩됩니다.

436358.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 집중 (2 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
436358.d:
정밀하고 강력한 공격을 연달아 날려 대상에게는 [(전투력의 531.455%) + (전투력의 531.455%) + (전투력의 1232.36%)]의 피해를, 10미터 내의 적에게는 (전투력의 1232.36%)의 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

쇄파에 정신을 집중하는 동안 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소하고 기절, 밀쳐내기, 강제 이동 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

쇄파에 정신을 집중하는 동안 방패 막기와 무기 막기, 회피가 가능하며 특정 방어 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다.

440992.d: 충격파 사용 시 추가로 적을 공중으로 날려 보내고 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소합니다.

444767.d:
주 대상에게 공격 시 25%의 확률로 대상의 방어를 압도하고 학살자의 일격을 발동시켜 (전투력의 840.42%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 집행자 중첩을 얻어 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다. 집행자는 여러 번 중첩됩니다.

(500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

444769.d:
학살자의 일격을 3회 사용할 때마다 급살이 부여됩니다.

급살 사용 시 다음 칼날폭풍이 가속화되어 추가로 1회 공격을 가합니다. 최대 3회의 공격을 가합니다. 칼날폭풍의 전체 지속시간은 변경되지 않습니다.

급살이 100%의 확률로 폭풍을 거두는 자를 100%의 효율로 발동시킵니다.

444780.d:
급살 사용 시 칼날폭풍의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소하고, 자신의 집행자 중첩 하나당 주 대상에게 압도당함 중첩 1개를 부여합니다.

칼날폭풍의 지속시간 동안 들이치기와 폭풍망치를 사용할 수 있습니다.

칼날폭풍의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1261051.d: 거인의 강타 사용 시 급살이 즉시 1회 부여됩니다.

1261056.d: 거인의 강타 사용 시 다음 20초 동안 사용하는 2회의 회전베기가 재사용 대기시간을 발생시키지 않습니다.

1261060.d:
마무리 일격이 대상에게 치명상을 부여합니다.

치명상
대상에게 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 145.48%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다. 이 효과가 다시 부여되면 남은 피해량을 새로운 치명상에 합산합니다.

1269307.d: 영웅의 일격 사용 시 다음 거인의 강타에 영향을 받는 적에게 입히는 피해가 3.0%만큼 추가로 증가합니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

1269383.d: 강력한 힘으로 적을 공격해 (전투력의 600%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 전쟁의 지배자 중첩이 부여되어 30초 동안 공격이 방어도를 3%만큼 관통합니다. 여러 번 사용 시 효과가 중첩됩니다.

1270704.d: 쇄파의 마지막 공격이 모든 대상에게 100%의 효율로 치명상을 부여합니다.

1270717.d: 칼날폭풍 사용 시 전투 몰입 상태가 되어, 칼날폭풍이 끝난 후 8초 동안 가속이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

1271925.d: 광전사의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼 감소하며, 시전 시 모든 이동 속도 저해 효과를 제거합니다.

1271926.d: 받는 치유 효과가 3%만큼, 모든 자가 치유량이 추가로 10%만큼 증가합니다.

1280961.d:
태세가 추가 효과를 부여합니다.

전투 태세
능력의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 3%만큼 증가합니다.

방어 태세
자신의 최대 생명력의 20%를 넘는 피해를 입히는 공격을 받으면, 그 공격으로 받는 피해가 15%만큼 감소합니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots that keep Radiant Spellsower walking toward the tank, and interrupt Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) with Pummel (15 sec, melee). The Slayer build can Pummel during Bladestorm thanks to Unrelenting Onslaught, so do not stop Bladestorm when your interrupt comes up.

[광역 피해] Once everything is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, turn on Sweeping Strikes and use Avatar (1 min 30 sec) together with Colossus Smash (45 sec). The Slayer build then fits Bladestorm inside the 10 sec Colossus Smash window; the Colossus build throws Ravager right before Colossus Smash and then uses Demolish. Pop Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove, stop Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel) with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 20 yd, 4 sec stun), then catch it with Charge (2 charges from Double Time) and apply Hamstring (50% movement slow for 15 sec) so it cannot run again.
2: [우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher wraps itself in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108), put Mortal Strike on that Lasher to break the shield. It is immune to crowd control while shielded, so Storm Bolt and Shockwave will not work.

[차단] If both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together, Pummel one and stun the other with Storm Bolt to stop its cast. If both are stacked in front of the tank, one Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec frontal stun) stops both.
[광역 피해] If the Spell Reflection (25 sec) you used in pull 1 is back, use it again for Spouting Floret, and top yourself off afterward with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health).
3: [제어] With 12 Lashers in this pull, a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove is dangerous. Stun it right away if Storm Bolt is ready; if not, catch it with Charge and apply Hamstring.

[차단] When the two Radiant Spellsowers gather in front of the tank with the Lasher pack, stun them together with Shockwave to stop Light Bolt Volley. Hitting 3 or more targets reduces Shockwave's cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.

[회피] If Virid Grovekeeper's Uproot (3 sec cast, 116379 Nature and a knockback) pushes you away, Charge straight back into melee, and clear the 40% slow from the Earthrupture Strike patch with Berserker Rage (30 sec with Fearless) as you step out.
5: [광역 피해] This is the first big pull after a boss, so line up Avatar and Colossus Smash with the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first, and pop Spell Reflection for Spouting Floret. When Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later, use Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) while Colossus Smash is still up.
[차단] Pummel Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient).
[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal cone and knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) can be stopped with a stun (Topicx), so stop it with Storm Bolt.
7: [차단] Pummel Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech. If Pummel is still ready, interrupt Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot too.

[제어] When both Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stun them together with Shockwave if both are in front of you; if they are apart, stop one with Storm Bolt and hand the other to a party member with a stun.

[참고] While the 5 Spineshield Beetles still have Spiny Shield (absorbs 500090), every hit from Sweeping Strikes, Cleave, or Bladestorm returns 4849 Nature damage to you. The Slayer build should start Bladestorm after the shields break, and if the reflected damage piles up, use Spell Reflection to take 20% less magic damage.
8: [광역 피해] Popping Spell Reflection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret also cuts the Spineshield Beetles' Spiny Shield reflected Nature damage by 20%. Top yourself off with Impending Victory afterward.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Shockwave or Storm Bolt, and if you have room, Pummel the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature).
10: [위치] Potatoad Matriarch is pulled immediately once someone crosses a certain spot on the floor, so do not Charge or Heroic Leap past that spot while clearing the Lashers.

[광역 피해] Clear the Lasher pack with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave, and save Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) for Potatoad Matriarch as you move in afterward. Arms cannot dispel Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature to the whole party plus a 9 sec poison), so pop Spell Reflection on the cast and add Die by the Sword (2 min, 30% less damage taken for 8 sec) if your health drops low.
[우선 처치] If the two Lightgorged Lashers wrap themselves in the Lightbloom Pollination shield, break the shields first with Mortal Strike. Storm Bolt and Shockwave do not work while they are shielded.
11: [제어] One Pummel (15 sec) cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech. Pummel one and Storm Bolt another, and if all three gather in front of you and cast together, stun them at once with Shockwave. Hitting 3 targets reduces its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so use Avatar and Colossus Smash with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager and Demolish (Colossus build). If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley (both Holy) overlap, add Die by the Sword on top of Spell Reflection.

[우선 처치] Among the 6 Lightgorged Lashers, put Mortal Strike on the ones wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield to break it. Shielded Lashers are immune to crowd control, so save Shockwave and Storm Bolt for the Radiant Spellsowers.
[차단] Put Pummel in the interrupt rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, and stun any one fleeing with Call The Grove with Storm Bolt, then apply Hamstring.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents and interrupt its Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical and 30% less haste) with Pummel (15 sec, melee). If you miss it, stop the cast with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun).

[제어] When the 7 Ravenous Descendants live long enough to start hitting the tank hard, Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec frontal stun) the pack gathered in front of the tank to stop the attacks that stack Ravenous Claws. Hitting 3 or more targets cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.

[회피] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slower per tick) piles up on you, clear every movement slow with Berserker Rage (30 sec with Fearless) and step out of the Toxic Breath frontal.
2: [우선 처치] Target Ritual Chieftain and line up Colossus Smash (45 sec) and Avatar (1 min 30 sec) on it. This six-mob pull is a cooldown pull (Topicx), so the Slayer build also uses Bladestorm and the Colossus build uses Ravager and Demolish.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party plus a heal absorb) hurts the most in this pull (Topicx), so pop Die by the Sword (2 min, 30% less damage taken for 8 sec) on the cast. It is Physical damage, so Spell Reflection does not reduce it.
3: [차단] There are three Primal Serpent casters, so one Pummel cannot cover them all. Once the Serpents walk down behind the pillar, Pummel one and stun another with Storm Bolt to stop Piercing Hiss.

[광역 피해] This is another pull where you can send cooldowns (Topicx), so put whatever Avatar and Colossus Smash you have back on Ritual Chieftain. If you used Die by the Sword in pull 2, top yourself off with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health) for Blood Sacrifice.
4: [차단] Pummel Piercing Hiss on one of the two Primal Serpents, and pop Die by the Sword for Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice if it is back.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull on the route. If the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots dots overlap Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice, pop Die by the Sword, and if the whole party's health drops, use Rallying Cry (3 min, raises party max health).
[우선 처치] Line up Colossus Smash and Avatar on Ritual Chieftain, and once the pack is gathered, cleave the Harrowers and Serpents with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave.
[회피] If the Paralyzing Shots slow stacks up, clear it with Berserker Rage (Fearless) so you can dodge the Toxic Breath frontal and the Septic Spatter pools.
7: [차단] Pummel High Evolutionist's Envenom. Always stop the Envenom right before Rattling Writhe starts Rattle (3 sec cast), because the dot and the AoE overlap. Stop Evolve (6 sec channel) by stunning it with Storm Bolt.
[제어] When the 3 Bloodletters gather in front of the tank, stun them together with Shockwave to stop their melee swings and blood pools.
[광역 피해] Pop Die by the Sword for Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec). It is Physical damage, so Spell Reflection does not help.
8: [제어] When the 4 Bloodletters gather in front of the tank, stun them together with Shockwave to stop the blood pools, and hit 3 or more so Rumbling Earth cuts its cooldown by 15 sec.
[광역 피해] If Die by the Sword is not ready for Rattling Writhe's Rattle, top yourself off with Impending Victory beforehand.
9: [차단] A ranged party member interrupts the far-left High Evolutionist to bring it in (Topicx), so you Pummel the near High Evolutionist's Envenom and Mass Envenom and stop its Evolve channel with Storm Bolt.
[우선 처치] High Evolutionist must die before its second Mass Envenom (Topicx), so line up Colossus Smash and Avatar on the High Evolutionists first.
11: [차단] Each of the 4 High Evolutionists gets an assigned interrupter, so Pummel Envenom on the one you own. Evolve channels are stopped with stuns (Topicx): stop one with Storm Bolt, and if several gather and channel together, stop them at once with Shockwave.
[제어] When a Blade of the Altar teleports behind a party member with Laced Edge, catch it with Charge (2 charges from Double Time) and lock it down with Storm Bolt.
12: [제어] When Infest bursts and Hatchlings spawn, Shockwave the Hatchlings where the party is stacked so they do not scatter. Topicx also recommends stunning them as they spawn.

[광역 피해] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest (Topicx), so line up Avatar and Colossus Smash on the Serpent and spread damage to Blade of the Altar and the Hatchlings with Sweeping Strikes. If you get Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec), pop Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec).
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be interrupted every time, so save Pummel for the Chosen.

[광역 피해] Do not melt the Living Venoms all at once with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build); if they die together, their Venom Burst stacks (Topicx). Line up Avatar and Colossus Smash on Ula'tek's Chosen.
[제어] During Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every 1 sec for 9 sec), lock down Blade of the Altar with Storm Bolt or Shockwave to stop its teleport strikes, and pop Spell Reflection for yourself.
14: [광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry as the party defensive for the Toxic Surge AoE (Topicx). If you did not use Die by the Sword in pull 13, pop it here too.
[제어] During Toxic Surge, stun both Blades of the Altar together with Shockwave or lock one down with Storm Bolt so they cannot teleport onto party members (Topicx).
15: [차단] Pummel Piercing Hiss on one of the two Primal Serpents.

[제어] When the 4 Blades of the Altar gather in front of the tank, stun them together with Shockwave. Hitting 3 or more cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth. Clear the Paralyzing Shots slow with Berserker Rage (Fearless).
16: [우선 처치] Kill Ula'tek's Chosen right away so it dies before the second Toxic Surge (Topicx): line up Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) on the Chosen, and Pummel Mass Envenom every time.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifice comes back to back and Toxic Surge overlaps it, so split your defensives: Die by the Sword for Blood Sacrifice and Rallying Cry for Toxic Surge. Pop Spell Reflection on the Toxic Surge cast as well.

1: [광역 피해] This is a Bloodlust pull, so line up Avatar (1 min 30 sec) and Colossus Smash (45 sec) on Bribed Captain first, then follow with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager and Demolish (Colossus build) on the Captain. Move to Bribed Guard once the Captain dies (Topicx).

[광역 피해] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed (155172 over 8 sec) overlaps other damage and your health drops hard, pop Die by the Sword (2 min, 30% less damage taken for 8 sec), and top yourself off with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health) afterward.
2: [차단] Seductive Sayaads get one interrupter each (Topicx), so Pummel (15 sec) Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) on the one you own, and stop it with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun) if you miss.
[회피] Felwyrms explode with a 4 yd Fel Detonation (193965 Fire) when they die, so when melting them together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave, take a step back after the killing blow.
3: [차단] Stop the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channels by Pummeling one and Storm Bolting the other.
[회피] If the 6 Felwyrms die together, their Fel Detonations stack, so pop Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) right before they burst or back out of 4 yd.
4: [제어] When the 4 Street Sneaks gather in front of the tank, stun them together with Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec frontal stun) to stop the attacks that stack Heartstop Poison. Hitting 3 or more cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.
5: [우선 처치] Massive Felwyrm is the priority target (Topicx), so line up Colossus Smash and Avatar on it, and when Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd) starts as it dies, get out of 10 yd and Charge back in.

[광역 피해] If Corroding Spittle (Fire, 30 sec dot) lands on you, pop Spell Reflection to take 20% less magic damage and call for a dispel. If Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec) stacks on top and your health drops, add Die by the Sword.
8: [차단] Pummel Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% less damage taken and crowd control immunity for 1 min). Once it lands, crowd control stops working, so spend Storm Bolt and Shockwave on other mobs.

[우선 처치] Below 50%, Shivan Punisher deals Fire damage to the party with Demonic Frenzy until it dies, so at 50% put Colossus Smash and Avatar on the Punisher to finish it fast. When you see Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd), get out of 12 yd and Charge back once it ends.
[차단] Interrupt Fel Invoker's Health Funnel channel with Pummel or Storm Bolt.
9: [광역 피해] If you are Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life target, pop Die by the Sword. Without a defensive, the warlock heals a lot (Topicx).

[우선 처치] When Corrupted Warlock casts its Dark Pact shield (30% of max health) at 50%, line up Colossus Smash, and the Colossus build breaks the shield with Demolish. Cut down the 8 Demon Flies together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave.
[차단] Stop the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage by Pummeling one and Storm Bolting the other.
10: [차단] Pummel Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (Topicx). Stop the other Invoker's channel with Storm Bolt.

[광역 피해] Once the 8 Demon Flies are gathered, use Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build), and save Avatar and Colossus Smash for when Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy.
11: [광역 피해] For Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (rapid 43642 Fire party hits), use a personal defensive on the first and party defensives on the next two (Topicx): Spell Reflection on the first Blade Dance and Rallying Cry (3 min, raises party max health) on the second.

[우선 처치] Pile Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) on Lucsei so Blade Dance does not go out more than three times. Sidestep Eye Beam (Chaos frontal) by moving to Lucsei's side.
13: [광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry on Defiled Golem's first Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the party) (Topicx). Avoid the Defiled Detonation spots (193965 Shadow within 5 yd) that follow.
[차단] Pummel Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage, and clear the 6 Unleashed Imps with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build) once they are stacked with the Golem pack.
14: [차단] Stop the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage one each with Pummel and Storm Bolt, and interrupt Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with whatever interrupt is left.
[제어] When the 6 Unleashed Imps gather in front of the tank, stun them together with Shockwave to stop Felfire Burst, then clear them with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave.
15: [우선 처치] Corrupted Warlock is pulled back and killed first (Topicx), so line up Colossus Smash and Avatar on the Warlock, and pop Die by the Sword if you are its Drain Life target.

[광역 피해] When you fight Shivan Punisher separately and its Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire every 1 sec) starts below 50%, pop Spell Reflection and pile your returning cooldowns on the Punisher to end it fast.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE should end within two casts (Topicx), so pile Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Demolish (Colossus build) on the Golem, and use Rallying Cry on one of the two Defiled Slams.
[차단] Fel Invokers get one interrupter each (Topicx), so Pummel Health Funnel on the one you own. Dodge Fel Beam by backpedaling toward the last boss.

1: [광역 피해] The first Bloodlust and cooldowns go on this pull (Topicx), so turn on Sweeping Strikes and use Avatar (1 min 30 sec) with Colossus Smash (45 sec), then follow with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager and Demolish (Colossus build).

[우선 처치] When the Starvation Effigy totem appears, switch your main target to the totem and break it with Mortal Strike. It must die before Insatiable Hunger (6 sec cast) lands its curse a second time (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 5 sec), and if Keen-Eyed Striker's Razor Dive bleed (33944 Physical every 1 sec, stacking) piles up, pop Die by the Sword (2 min, 30% less damage taken for 8 sec).
2: [차단] Pummel (15 sec) Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature). If the next cast comes before Pummel is back, stop it with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun).
[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem right away with Mortal Strike, and pop Spell Reflection for the Feast of Misery channel.
3: [차단] Pummel Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze, and stop it with Storm Bolt if you miss. Break the Starvation Effigy totem right away with Mortal Strike.
4: [우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first with Mortal Strike, and if the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds stack up, hold on with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health) or Die by the Sword.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx), so once everything is gathered in the corner, use Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build).
[차단] Stop the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze by Pummeling one and Storm Bolting the other. If both are stacked in front of the tank, one Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec frontal stun) stops both.
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up, the whole party takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so line up Colossus Smash on the Rumbler, and the Colossus build puts Demolish on it to break the shield fast. Sweeping Strikes spreads damage to the 5 Frostfangs.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx), so use Avatar, Colossus Smash, and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager and Demolish (Colossus build), and put the burst into the Terra Rumbler with Rumbling Ward first.

10: [차단] Stop the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar by Pummeling one and Storm Bolting the other.

11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first and Terra Rumbler next (Topicx), so line up Avatar and Colossus Smash on Avatar of Determination.

15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so split your defensives: Die by the Sword for the first Echo and Rallying Cry (3 min) as the party defensive for the next. Topicx also named this pull as a spot for raid defensives.

16: [차단] Pummel Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

1: [광역 피해] The first corridor is pulled all the way to Voidtouched Magi with Bloodlust (Topicx), so turn on Sweeping Strikes, line up Avatar (1 min 30 sec) and Colossus Smash (45 sec) on the Magi, then follow with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager and Demolish (Colossus build).

2: [광역 피해] Raj'kess the Spellstorm's Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 nearby players) can be reflected. It can bounce to you even if you are not the target, so pop Spell Reflection on the cast (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry (3 min, raises party max health) on the first or second Thundering Storm party AoE (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] If Rallying Cry is back, use it for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec) (Topicx), and pop Spell Reflection for yourself. Avoid the Ravenous Swarm patches.

5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important interrupt in this area (Topicx), so hold Pummel for it. If it is missed and you are feared, break the fear with Berserker Rage and come right back.

[광역 피해] If you are Watchful Harrower's Void Beam target (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), move out of the party and pop Spell Reflection. Everyone stands in the Sky Strike circle to split it.
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer casts its Brutal Slams shield, line up Colossus Smash and Avatar on the Overseer, and the Colossus build breaks the shield fast with Demolish. Kill the Overseer before its next shield so it does not overlap the Sky Strike soak (Topicx).

8: [우선 처치] Switch right away to the low-health mob (marked with an icon) that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast). If it is below 20% health, finish it with Execute, and if Sudden Death is up, use Execute right away regardless of its health.

[광역 피해] Dreadbellow (knockback plus 29095 Shadow every 1 sec for 12 sec, not dispellable) is magic damage, so pop Spell Reflection (Topicx) and Charge back after the knockback. This is a damage cooldown pull (Topicx), so use Avatar and Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build).
[차단] Pummel Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek, and break the fear with Berserker Rage if you are hit. Interrupt Voidminder's Mending Void with Storm Bolt when you have room.
9: [광역 피해] Once the 10 Scavenging Siphoids are gathered, turn on Sweeping Strikes and clear them together with Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Ravager (Colossus build).
[우선 처치] Switch right away to the Devour target (marked with an icon) and finish it with Execute or Mortal Strike, and Pummel Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek. Pop Spell Reflection for Dreadbellow.
10: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow, and once Watchful Harrower joins, keep Die by the Sword for when you are the Void Beam target.

2: [차단] Interrupt Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse dot) with Pummel (15 sec), and if you have room, stop Shadowfrost Bolt too with Pummel or Storm Bolt.

4: [우선 처치] Charge into the awakened pack and pop damage cooldowns only after the tank has threat (Topicx). Save Avatar and Ravager (Colossus build) for the hardest King A'akul and Bloodsworn Assassin pack.

6: [차단] Take one of the 2 Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease dot on the whole party) with Pummel (Topicx). Arms cannot remove diseases, so if the other one is about to be missed, stop it with Storm Bolt.

[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Storm Bolt, and interrupt Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Pummel.

[차단] A Lightning Bolt on someone hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx), so split the 2 Storm Adepts between Pummel and Storm Bolt. Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec stun) when the mobs are stacked.

6: [차단] Interrupt the 2 Brood Tenders' Venom Bolt (116379 Nature) one each with Pummel and Storm Bolt. One person is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) (Topicx), so if someone is assigned to it, spend Pummel on Venom Bolt.
[위치] When the 2 Lightning Serpents' Serpent's Stormcall ends, a pool forms under them, so follow with Charge or Heroic Leap when the tank moves the mobs and hit them outside the pool (Topicx).
7: [차단] Interrupt Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Pummel so it does not land on top of Cytotoxin (Topicx), and stop Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Storm Bolt. Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Shockwave.
[광역 피해] When the 3 Poisonous Vipers' Cytotoxin (72737 Nature plus a 10 sec dot) stacks up, pop Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec). Arms cannot remove poisons.
9: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection on Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole party). The pulls are chained so the two Nimbuses' Release Charges alternate (Topicx), so use Die by the Sword for the second one.
[차단] Interrupt Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Pummel and Storm Bolt so nothing slips through while Release Charge goes off (Topicx).
[회피] Do not rush the Loose Sparks section (290947 Nature plus a 6 sec stun) with Charge or Heroic Leap; dodge first (Topicx), then kill the Spark Channeler first to stop the orbs.
10: [차단] The 2 Imbued Stormcallers are stopped before the other mobs are gathered (Topicx), so take one with Pummel and the other with Storm Bolt. If several Static Anomalies are up, stun them together with Shockwave (15 sec shorter through Rumbling Earth).
[광역 피해] This is a dangerous pull with the Nimbus, casters, and Static Anomalies together (Topicx), so pop Spell Reflection on Release Charge and Die by the Sword if things overlap.
12: [차단] Interrupt the tank-side Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption (a channel that blocks the orb charge) with Pummel, and hold the opposite Disruptor with Storm Bolt (Topicx). They stop casting once the orb reaches 100%.

[광역 피해] The gathered Faithless Conscripts give no count, so hit them with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave but keep your damage on the Orb Watcher (Topicx). Pop Spell Reflection on Caustic Stomp (Nature to the whole party plus a 10 sec dot).

13: [차단] Split this orb's Temple Disruptors between Pummel and Storm Bolt to block Essence Disruption, and pop Spell Reflection on Caustic Stomp (Topicx).
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec dot) must be interrupted and the Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so save Pummel for the Hexxer.
